opportunities.point: Management announced the commissioning of a 3.2-meter single S line and a 1.6-meter single S production line.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "We recently commissioned our 3.2-meter single S line and 1.6-meter single S production lines, enhancing our ability to meet rising demand." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management commissioned a 6.5 megawatt ground-mounted solar power plant across the group.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "In line with our commitment to sustainability and cost efficiency, we have also commissioned 6.5 megawatt of ground-mounted solar power plant across the group, in addition to our rooftop installation." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Sales are outgrowing costs - operating leverage should widen margins.
Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
Management stated that the hygiene sector remained their largest vertical, contributing over 50% of the revenue.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The hygiene sector remained our largest vertical, contributing over 50% of the revenue, followed by packaging and medical applications." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management noted that India would be a much larger market for spunbond fabric used in hygiene products.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "So, I think India would be a much larger market for the category called spunbond, or the fabric that is used into the hygiene production for babies, sanitary pads, and all those applications." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The group installed capacity stands at 39,140 MTPA across 7 lines.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Group installed capacity: 39,140 MTPA across 7 lines" (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that they aim to reach 80% to 85% capacity utilization on lines 6 and 7 within one and a half years.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So, that would be around one and a half year, one or one and a half year. We tried to make it before that, but to be on a practical side, it would take around one and a half year to reach up to 80% or 85% of the capacity utilization." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [1.5 years]

opportunities.point: Management stated they will try to maintain revenue growth and slightly improve PAT margins over the next one to two years.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "going forward for, let's say, 1 or 2 years, we can say that we will try to maintain the revenue growth by what we are seeing this year, and we will try to make it slightly higher into the PAT margin in upcoming one to two years." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [1-2 years]

opportunities.point: The headline earnings multiple is low, leaving room if profits hold.
Historically strong quarters (Mar) are still in the cycle.

threats.point: A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -0.82 pp, DII -0.41 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Management noted that uncertainty in the market still causes polypropylene price hikes.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Still, there is uncertainty into the market, so because of that, we are still seeing such kind of hike, but I think once the situation will go down, it will come to the normalisation." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
